sections.title: I-CAR Platinum
body: I-CAR Platinum is a nationally recognized achievement earned by collision repair professionals who've spent hours mastering the skills needed to work on today's vehicles.
It represents advanced training, up-to-date knowledge, and a deep commitment to performing safe, quality repairs the right way every time.

sections.title: What Is Platinum?
body: The Platinum designation is awarded to individuals who complete I-CAR's detailed, role-specific collision repair training.

Whether you're an automotive technician, estimator, or appraiser, earning Platinum shows you understand the latest vehicle systems and repair procedures. It also helps your business earn or maintain I-CAR's Gold Class recognition.

sections.title: Platinum Training Standards
body: Platinum training is structured across three levels: ProLevel 1, 2, and 3. To maintain your Platinum status, you must complete six training course credits each year by your renewal date.
Falling behind puts your recognition at risk, but your progress isn't lost. Completed ProLevel credits are retained, and any missed training can be completed to reinstate Platinum.
sections.embedHtml:
Complete ProLevel 1 + ProLevel 2 + ProLevel 3 = Platinum Achieved

Complete Annual Training each year = Platinum Maintained

sections.title: Appraiser Platinum Changes
sections.label: What's New
body: Starting August 2026, Auto Physical Damage Appraisers will need to complete ProLevel 1, 2, and 3 training to become Platinum.
This auto collision training ensures APDAs are prepared for the future of claims processing and advanced vehicle technology, staying aligned with industry standards.
